temporal_state_chain.observed: Alice has noticed Austin is reserved when they talk about work; at coffee, he first says it is just usual ups and downs, then admits he is unsure how to handle some complicated things at work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Austin might be hiding something about his job performance because of his changed demeanor at work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—his evasiveness partly gives way to an admission that something specific and complicated at work is bothering him, so the issue seems less like simple concealment of performance and more like work difficulty he is struggling to discuss.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Austin is dealing with a complicated work-related problem and may not be fully open about it; he may need support to talk.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Encourage Austin to open up and offer support so she can understand and help with whatever is troubling him at work.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Austin says he has thought about a career change but does not know what other paths he could take; he asks Alice for suggestions. Alice suggests healthcare, offers to share experiences and contacts, and Austin says he would like to know more.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Austin may be considering a career change because of dissatisfaction at work; Alice is worried about his well-being.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Austin confirms he has considered a career change and shows interest in healthcare when Alice raises it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Austin is open to exploring a healthcare career change and wants to learn from Alice's experience and contacts.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Worried for his well-being, but hopeful and eager to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Share her healthcare experiences and discuss potential career paths, with the possibility of introducing him to contacts.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Austin is inspired by Lara's story but says he worries about risks and the initial struggle; he thanks Alice and says her support and real success stories help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Austin is interested in changing careers but may be hesitant because he fears the unknown.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—his hesitation is confirmed as fear of risk and early struggle, but he is also responsive to encouragement and values Alice's support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Austin remains cautious and fearful about a career change, yet encouragement, real examples, and ongoing support can help him persist.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: A mix of frustration and empathy, then patience, encouragement, and hope.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Encourage Austin, reassure him that fear is natural, and continue sharing stories of people who successfully changed careers later in life.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Austin accepts Alice's offers to connect him with a career counselor and friends in healthcare; he says it would be helpful, appreciates it, and looks forward to the meeting next week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Austin is still cautious but has become open to discussing a career change and receiving encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—his acceptance of concrete connections and a planned meeting shows he is willing to take practical steps toward a transition.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Austin is receptive to detailed guidance and ready to explore a healthcare transition with Alice's help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Provide detailed guidance, connect Austin with a career counselor and healthcare friends, and set up the meeting for next week.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After several discussions and meetings, Austin tells Alice he feels excited and a bit nervous, but mostly grateful; he agrees to regular check-ins to stay focused and get her perspective.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Austin is ready to take the next steps in his career transition and appreciates Alice's help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—his excitement, nervousness, gratitude, and agreement to regular check-ins confirm his engagement and ongoing need for support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Austin is actively moving forward with the transition, values Alice's help, and will benefit from regular check-ins on progress and challenges.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Plan and maintain regular check-ins with Austin to discuss his progress and challenges.
